items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: >> [SPEAKER_03] Mel's Blue Rhythm? Dewey Jackson? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, he played Dewey Jackson, but he was with a big band of Missourians, I think. Oh yeah, Fountain Blue.

ctx.x: I think that's the rhythm. Who did the guy play with?

Yeah, he played Dewey Jackson, but he was with a big band of Missourians, I think. Oh yeah, Fountain Blue. Fountain Blue. I don't know if that's a Fountain Blue song. They both flew up on the staff. What's the name of the record?
